description:
List IVR mapping jobs in your workspace. Supports filtering and cursor pagination.

    FILTERS (all optional):
    - status: Filter by the latest run's status. Values: idle | running | completed | failed | limited.
      Each job's `status` is its latest run's status (`idle` if it has never run), and the filter
      compares against it — so `status=completed` returns jobs whose most recent
      run finished, and `status=running` returns jobs with an in-flight run.
    - tag: Filter to jobs with this tag (exact, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, e.g. 'compliance-eu').
    - phoneNumber: Filter by exact E.164 phone number (e.g. '+441234567890').
    - name: Case-insensitive substring match against the job name.
    - profileId: Filter to jobs using a specific mapping profile (a `profile_…` id from listProfiles).
    - createdAfter / createdBefore: ISO-8601 datetime strings (e.g. '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'). Efficient
      DDB range filter — both, either, or neither.
    - limit: Page size, 1-100, default 50.

    SORTING:
    - sortDir: 'asc' or 'desc' (default 'desc' = newest first). Sort is always by createdAt.

    PAGINATION:
    - Pass `cursor` (from a previous response's `nextCursor`) to get the next page.
    - When `nextCursor` is absent from the response, you are on the last page.
    - LOSSY-PAGINATION CAVEAT: When filtering by `status`, paged results may underfill (return fewer
      than `limit` items) because the status filter is applied after the DDB query. Always follow
      `nextCursor` until it is absent to be sure you have all matches.

    RESULT FIELDS:
    - id: UUID — use with `getMapping` for full detail (run state, step counts) or `getMappingTree`
      for the discovered IVR tree (once the latest run has status=`completed`).
    - status: The latest run's status (so `completed`, `failed` or `limited` once it has finished); `idle` when the job has never run.
    - tags: String labels for grouping. Set via `createMapping` / mapping update.
    - config: Includes mappingMode, maxDepth, maxCalls, probeMode.
    - runNumber: The run number of the latest run, if any.

    USAGE PATTERNS:
    - "List my 5 most recent mappings" → { limit: 5, sortDir: 'desc' }
    - "Show running mapping jobs" → { status: 'running' }
    - "Mappings tagged compliance-eu" → { tag: 'compliance-eu' }
    - "Mappings created this week" → { createdAfter: '<start-of-week ISO>' }
    - "Find runs for +44... in detail" → call listMappings { phoneNumber: '+44...' } then getMapping(id)

createdAfter.description: ISO-8601 datetime; return jobs created at or after this time.

createdBefore.description: ISO-8601 datetime; return jobs created before this time.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor` to fetch the next page.

hasRun.description:
mapping-pages-discarded-cursor fix. When true, filter to jobs with at
least one run (latest run's status != idle). When false, only idle
jobs. Independent of `status` — both may be combined. Post-merge
filter, same underfill caveat as `status` applies: always follow
`nextCursor` until absent.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the job name.

phoneNumber.description: Filter by exact E.164 phone number.

profileId.description: Filter to jobs using a specific mapping profile.

search.description:
mapping-pages-discarded-cursor fix. Case-insensitive OR substring
match across job `name` and `phoneNumber` — server-side equivalent
of the Map Results page search box. Distinct from the exact-match
`name`/`phoneNumber` filters above, which remain ANDed when both
given and are unchanged by this addition.

sortDir.description: Sort direction by createdAt (default desc = newest first).

status.description: Filter by the latest run's status.

tag.description: Filter to jobs with this tag (exact, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens).

name: listMappings

outputSchema.description: Response from `GET /mapping`. Slim projection with cursor pagination.

items.description:
Slim projection of a mapping job returned by `GET /mapping` list endpoint.
Full detail (stats, steps, run history) is available via `GET /mapping/{id}`.

config.description:
Per-job configuration knobs that govern exploration shape and call orchestration.
Sensible defaults are applied server-side when fields are omitted on create.

carrierRouteId.description:
Bring-your-own-carrier (invite-only). Dial this map's calls through one of the
workspace's carrier routes, over the workspace's own SIP trunk, instead of nopaque's
network. Checked when the map is created or updated (400 when it cannot be dialled, 503
when it could not be looked up). Each run records the route it started through
(`carrier`), and every call of the run checks it again, with the trunk's daily minutes:
a start that cannot dial is refused (409, 429 for today's minutes, 403 or 503), and a
call later in the map that cannot (the route was disabled, or the trunk used today's
minutes) fails that step with the reason, so the map stops dialling. Never a normal
call instead. Send `null` on update to clear it. Carrier calls are metered as
`carrier_mapping` (`carrier_s2s` for full-audio maps), from answer.

dataProfileId.description: Data profile for variable substitution in scripted inputs.

enrichmentConfig.description:
Enrichment pipeline configuration. Controls whether async post-map enrichment
runs after a mapping run completes (quality scoring, transcript analysis, etc.).

enabled.description: Whether enrichment runs automatically after each mapping run completes.

types.description: Which enrichment types to run. Defaults to `["quality_scoring"]`.

allOf.description:
The transcription language of a STANDARD test or a MAPPING run — the
language the callee is expected to speak, used to transcribe the call.
Absent means `en-GB`: every omit path is unchanged, so an existing
config without the field transcribes as British English exactly as
before. Anything outside this set is rejected with 400.

The English variants lead, then `multi` (code-switching), then the
remaining languages alphabetically by display label. Mirrors
`api/packages/core/transcription/languages.ts` (Zod) — the single
source of truth; a drift test keeps this enum equal to it.

DISTINCT from `CallLanguage`, which is the language a MISSION test
call is held in. The two lists do not overlap cleanly and are not
interchangeable: bare `en` is a valid `CallLanguage` and is INVALID
here (use `en-GB` or `en-US`), and most codes here are not call
languages at all.

language.description:
Transcription language for this mapping run. Omitted means `en-GB`.
Must be one of the `TranscriptionLanguage` codes — NOT a
`CallLanguage`: bare `en` is rejected with 400.

mappingMode.description:
Mapping mode. `dtmf` is keypad-only; `dtmf-audio` mixes DTMF + voice;
`full-audio` is voice-first (no keypad).

maxDepth.description: Maximum tree depth to explore (0 = root only).

probeMode.description:
Phase 31 security-probe mode flag. Requires a prior attestation via
`POST /mapping/attest` for the target phone number.

repeatConfig.description:
Repeat-detection configuration. Controls how the orchestrator handles
situations where a discovered menu is revisited via a different DTMF path
(a loop). `skip` ignores the revisit entirely; `explore_once` explores it
the first time only; `explore_n` explores up to `maxExplorations` times.

behavior.description: Behaviour when a repeated menu is detected.

retryConfig.description:
Retry configuration for failed mapping calls. Controls whether transient call
failures (no answer, busy, telephony errors) are retried before being marked failed.

enabled.description: Whether retries are enabled for this job.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts per failed call (1-5).

vertical.description: Industry vertical used for prompt-library lookup.

voiceProfileId.description: Voice profile for TTS responses (full-audio / dtmf-audio modes).

error.description: Error message if the latest run failed.

phoneNumber.description: Target phone number in E.164 format.

runNumber.description: Run number of the latest run, if any.

status.description:
The latest run's status, copied onto the job, so it can be `completed`,
`failed` or `limited` once that run has finished. `idle` when the job has
never run.

tags.description: String labels for filtering and grouping.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64-encoded cursor. Pass back in `cursor` query param to fetch next page. Absent on the last page.

nextToken.description: Alias for nextCursor (frontend back-compat). Absent on the last page.
